age.evidence: Male Wistar Han rats (7 weeks old, weighing approximately 220 g) and Wistar-Kyoto rats (7 weeks old, weighing approximately 200 g)

sex.evidence: Male Wistar Han rats ... and Wistar-Kyoto rats ... were used for the experiments.

dosing.evidence: Psilocybin was dissolved in physiological saline (vehicle) and administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a single dose of 0.3 mg/kg of body weight.

handling.evidence: No handling protocol described in methods.

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12-hour light/dark cycle (lights on at 7 a.m.). Behavioral testing was conducted during the light phase of the light/dark cycle.

assays.assay_description: Open field arena (66 × 56 × 30 cm, 25 lx). Two 3-min trials separated by 24 h ITI (familiarization T1, retention T2). Repeated 6 days later (NORT 1 at 4 h post-drug; NORT 2 at 6 days post-drug). Measures: Discrimination Index, novel/familiar object exploration time, total exploration, distance traveled.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a single dose of 0.3 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Prior to testing, each rat was habituated to the arena (without any objects) for 5 min, 24 h before the actual test.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were tested in a dimly lit open field; freely moving.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in the open-field arena during the 3-min trial.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in the open-field arena during the 3-min trial.

time_to_assay.evidence: The acquisition phase of the NORT test was conducted 4 h and 6 days after drug administration.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin did not significantly affect the Discrimination Index, total exploration time, or distance traveled at either 4 h or 6 days post-administration. WKY rats showed lower DI and shorter distance traveled than WIS rats, independent of treatment.
outcomes.statistics: Strain effect on DI: F(1,34)=12.68, p=0.001; distance traveled strain effect F(1,34)=24.82, p<0.001; phase F(1,34)=27.20, p<0.001; time, treatment and interactions nonsignificant.
outcomes.evidence: time, treatment, and interactions between factors were nonsignificant

B1_num_measures.evidence: DI, exploration time of novel object, exploration time of familiar object, total exploration time, distance traveled.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: 3-min trial totals reported; no within-session time-bin analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Object exploration defined as looking/licking/sniffing/touching — task-defined exploration, not natural repertoire scoring.

B5_social.evidence: Animal tested alone in object arena.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Any-Maze tracking system (position tracking); exploration manually scored.

E1_environment_type.evidence: open field made of dull grey plastic (66 × 56 × 30 cm)

E2_shelter.evidence: Open field provides no enclosed refuge.

E5_enrichment.evidence: Test objects do not count; no other enrichment.

D1_continuity.evidence: NORT 1 (4 h post) and NORT 2 (6 days post), each with T1 and T2 trials.

D3_recording_days.evidence: NORT 1 at 4 h, NORT 2 at 6 days; each with T1 and T2 on consecutive days = multiple recording days.

D4_baseline.evidence: Drug administered before T1; no pre-drug recording.

assays.assay_description: Dimly lit open field (57 × 67 × 30 cm, 15 lx). Pairs of unfamiliar same-treatment rats interact for 10 min. Behaviors scored: sniffing, anogenital sniffing, social grooming, climbing, following, crawling (duration and episode counts). Conducted 2 days (SI 1) and 8 days (SI 2) post-PSI.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a single dose of 0.3 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats were individually placed in the open field for 5 min one day before the test to adapt them to the testing area.

food_restriction.evidence: No food in arena during 10-min test.

water_restriction.evidence: No water in arena during 10-min test.

time_to_assay.evidence: The SI test was conducted 2 days and 8 days after PSI administration.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin increased total social interaction time across strains, with a strain-specific temporal pattern: WIS rats showed significant increase at SI 1 (2 d), while WKY rats showed significant increase at SI 2 (8 d). Specific behaviors increased included anogenital sniffing and following.
outcomes.evidence: PSI increased the time of social interactions in both strains... In WIS rats, SI 1 p=0.029; in WKY rats, SI 2 p<0.001.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Total interaction time + duration AND number of episodes for sniffing, anogenital sniffing, grooming, climbing, following, crawling.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No sequence or transition analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Sniffing, anogenital sniffing, social grooming, climbing, following, crawling — natural social repertoire.

B5_social.evidence: Two unfamiliar rats were placed in the open-field arena and behaviors were recorded for 10 min.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Videos analyzed offline using Noldus EthoVision XT (position tracking).

E7_social_context.evidence: Two unfamiliar rats placed together in the open-field arena without barrier.

D1_continuity.evidence: SI 1 at 2 d and SI 2 at 8 d post-treatment.

D5_followup.evidence: SI tests performed 2 and 8 days post-treatment (>24 h).

assays.assay_description: Opaque cylinders (21 cm diameter, water 23-25 °C, depth 30 cm). Pre-test 15 min, test 5 min 24 h later; repeated at 23 days post-PSI. 5-min test scored in 60 × 5-s intervals for immobility, swimming, climbing.

application_type.evidence: administered intraperitoneally (i.p.) at a single dose of 0.3 mg/kg

setup_habituation.evidence: Pre-test (15 min) recorded but is part of the FST procedure, not separate habituation; no habituation to apparatus prior to pre-test reported.

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder — animal in water cylinder with no escape (rubric classifies FST cylinder as restraint).

food_restriction.evidence: No food in cylinder during the test.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water available; cylinder contains immersion water.

time_to_assay.evidence: The FST was performed 9 days and 23 days after drug administration.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin reduced immobility in WKY rats at FST 1 (9 d post) with concomitant increase in climbing; in WIS rats, PSI reduced immobility at FST 2 (23 d post) with increased swimming and climbing. Effects were strain- and time-dependent.
outcomes.statistics: Immobility: strain F(1,28)=43.88, p<0.001; drug F(1,28)=5.54, p=0.026; time×drug F(1,28)=6.84, p=0.014; time×strain×drug F(1,28)=6.45, p=0.017. WKY FST 1 p=0.0495; WIS FST 2 p=0.012; WKY climbing FST 1 p=0.030; WIS swimming FST 2 p=0.049.
outcomes.evidence: Post hoc pairwise comparisons revealed differences in immobility time between VEH- and PSI-treated WKY rats in FST 1 (p = 0.0495)... in FST 2, there was a significant reduction in immobility time in WIS rats after PSI treatment (p = 0.012).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Immobility, swimming, climbing — durations and 5-s interval mean counts for each.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: 5-min session divided into 5-s intervals for scoring, but data aggregated as mean counts; no within-session time-course analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/swimming/climbing not classified as ethological per rubric.

E1_environment_type.evidence: opaque cylinders (21 cm in diameter), filled with water

D1_continuity.evidence: Pre-test (15 min) and test (5 min) on consecutive days at 8-9 d; repeated again at 22-23 d post-PSI.

D3_recording_days.evidence: Pre-test day + FST 1 + pre-test 2 + FST 2 across the schedule = multiple recording days within 2-7 range.

judge_notes: Three assays identified: NORT, SI, FST. All candidates agreed on this set.
B1 for NORT set to 2 (4-6 measures: DI, novel exploration, familiar exploration, total exploration, distance) consistent with gptoss/glm; qwen undercounted.
B1 for SI set to 3 (7+) given duration AND episode counts across 6 behaviors plus total time — matches gptoss.
B4 for NORT scored 0: object exploration is task-defined, not natural-repertoire scoring per rubric examples.
FST D2 scored 1 (15-60 min) because the 15-min pre-test recording session counts as the longest single session for this assay; gptoss correctly flagged this.
FST setup_restrain set to yes per rubric ('FST cylinder' is explicitly listed as restraint).
B2 for FST scored 0: although the 5-min session was binned into 5-s intervals for scoring, no within-session time-course was analyzed/reported as temporal dynamics — only mean counts.
Housing fields (handling, group_housing, enrichment) marked not_reported with low confidence; light cycle is reported as standard (not flipped).
